limits: This verifies the captured API policy against the repository scorer inputs; it does not prove deployed validator configuration identity.
All existing geometric allocations, including unpaid ones, count as rivals; first must be strictly greater, not tied.
Candidate shares assume admission and a distinct eligible hotkey; neither private results nor formal payout are established.
Discovery, independent confirmation and incidental controls stay separate. Observed counts are not success probabilities.
